## Changes since `v0.7.1-beta.4`

### Features

- back up and sync how the connections panel lists profiles: the By group / Last used switch was kept only in this device's local storage, so neither a backup nor WebDAV sync carried it; it is now the profile_sort setting in the config file, which backups take with the other settings, and it is among the settings sync shares, since listing by last use means the same on every device ([bd7855e2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/bd7855e2d939ea817a8427e70ad32cfc41a6eaa0))
- copy and paste in the terminal with Ctrl+Shift+C / V, and show them in its context menu: the menu's Copy and Paste showed no shortcut, since neither was a keymap action, and from the keyboard copying and pasting were left to whatever the webview did with a chord xterm passes on, which for Ctrl+Shift+C is likely inspecting an element rather than copying; both are now keymap actions, bound to Ctrl+Shift+C / V on Windows and Linux and left unbound on macOS, where Cmd+C / V already copy and paste and Cmd+V uploads to SFTP, and they serve only a focused terminal so a text field elsewhere keeps the chord ([c03baf98](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c03baf9836ce8868b4e2ee30f78335f47e7e02cd))
- put the saved connection a search fits best first: matches were listed in their saved order, so typing a connection's full name could leave it below others that only matched its user, and the launcher, which shows eight, could cut it off; a match on the name itself now comes first, then the start of the name or of a word in it, then every word in the name or the start of the host, then a match anywhere else, with the connection used last first among equals; the launcher ranks before it cuts, and the panel ranks its recent list and, by group, each group and the order of the groups, so Enter opens the best fit ([901544d8](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/901544d81c18af555b23487f5c2134141174f967))
- list the connections panel by last use: with many groups, the connections used every day were spread over all of them; a switch beside the search now lists every connection in one list, the one used last first and the ones never used after in the saved order, each row naming its group, while By group keeps the groups as they were; the choice is remembered on this device ([a8460754](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/a846075420c9b988e5af858f3984abdd8370c014))
- list the saved connections used lately in the new tab launcher: its recents held only quick connections, so a saved connection opened every day had to be searched for each time; a saved connection now counts as used each time one of its tabs connects, SSH or serial, the launcher lists it among the recents with the quick connections, newest first, and a search puts the saved connections used lately before the others; like the other recents they stay on this device, are not synced, and go into backups with the settings ([f9bc8e35](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/f9bc8e35842c3f9c429862e1f0c9e8044e8e5ff1))

### Fixes

- match each word of a connection search on its own: the connections panel looked for the whole query as one run of text in the joined fields, so "web root" found nothing for a connection named web-01 with the user root, while the new tab launcher found it; the panel now matches the way the launcher does, every word anywhere in the name, group, host, username, connection type or serial port, and its placeholder names the username it already searched ([738caf30](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/738caf30b30e76c5eb5a6e034e486488ecf795b7))
- upload a file dropped on an SFTP drawer to the pane under the cursor, not to another tab: the window drop listener was registered again on every directory change, and when it was cleaned up before its registration finished it was never stopped, so it kept uploading every later drop into the directory of the tab it was made for, whichever tab was in front; a listener that arrives after its cleanup is now stopped at once, it is registered only as the drawer opens, and the drawer in the pane under the cursor takes the drop, since a file dragged in from another window leaves the focus on the pane clicked last, while a drop outside every pane still goes to the focused drawer ([cb5a9eeb](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/cb5a9eeb61a3dd15165aa7e414377ee4d02edf23))
